title: PolicySet
description: The ordered list of Policies that apply to traffic entering from one Interface/Zone and leaving through another (R-014, R-014.4). Replaces the v0 kind 'Rules'. The (from, to) pair is a match criterion, so PolicySets for different pairs never overlap: ordering is only meaningful inside one PolicySet, and it is the position in the 'policies' array. Exactly one PolicySet per (from, to) pair (validator check). 'any' is NOT allowed for from/to: use a Zone containing the relevant Interfaces instead (RA open issue 4). Traffic for a pair with no PolicySet gets Default Deny (R-033).

addressList.description: Either ['any'] or a non-empty list of Address / AddressGroup / VirtualIP names.

serviceList.description: Either ['any'] or a non-empty list of Service / ServiceGroup names.

name.description: Unique within the PolicySet; reported in Traffic Log events (R-026) and in the UI.

log.description: Which Flow events to emit for this Policy. Default Deny always logs (R-033).

snat.description: Source NAT for accepted Flows (R-002). Only valid with action=accept.

translateTo.description: 'outgoing-interface' = masquerade to the primary address of the outgoing Interface. A literal address pins the translation.

schedule.description: Reserved for a future Schedule kind. Not implemented in v1alpha1.
